observations: Two brown sofas with gold-colored diamond-shaped trim on the armrests.
Photo 1 shows the same two sofas with two throw pillows on the left sofa and one on the right sofa.
Photo 2 shows a single brown sofa with a single throw pillow on the left side.
All sofas appear to be made of fabric with a quilted backrest design.
The sofas are in a living room setting with tiled flooring and wall art.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in the photos.
The seller claims '2 seater and 1 sofa', but photo 1 shows two sofas and one sofa, totaling three pieces.

claims.claim: Used 2 seater and 1 sofa in great condition
claims.evidence: Photos show the sofas in good condition with no visible damage or wear. The fabric appears intact, and the gold trim is intact.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear not visible in photos, such as stains, tears, or loose upholstery.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the fabric, especially on the backrests and seat cushions, and under the armrests.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential hidden damage, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: The sofas may not be in the claimed condition (e.g., one sofa is damaged or the other is missing).
risks.proof: Photos showing the condition of each piece individually, including the backrests and seat cushions.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a mixed set with potential for lower value due to unverified condition.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the fabric on the backrests and seat cushions of each sofa.
Photos showing the condition of the armrests and any visible seams or stitching.
Photos of the underside of the sofas to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
